# Support

Trosive is an early-stage open-source project maintained on a best-effort basis.

- Use the bug report form for reproducible defects.
- Use the feature request form for product proposals.
- Use the question form for development or usage questions.
- Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities and sensitive reports.

Search existing issues before opening a new one and include enough context to
reproduce the problem. Never attach confidential documents, credentials,
personal data, or unredacted user content.

The hosted service and account support channels are not available yet.
